newsitem.headline: TABLE - First Southern Q2 full results.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: On July 17, 1996, the co reported 1996 Q2 EPS of nil.

The co said operating results were impacted by non interest expense for the planned termination of its benefit retirement plan, for which it recognized an expense of $588,000 for the unfunded projected liability. Impact on EPS was about $0.20 for Q2 and six months ended June 30, 1997.
Q2 1997 net interest income after provision for loan losses was $1,771,000, or 9 percent less than the $1,935,000 reported for the comparable period in 1996.
For six months ending June 30, 1997, net interest income after provision for loan losses of $3,538,000, consistent with the $3,555,000 reported for comparable period in 1996.
Full co name is First Southern Bancshares Inc.
